summary: Lear Corporation filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026 announcing that its Board approved raising its share repurchase authorization to $1.5 billion and extending the program's term to December 31, 2029. At Q2 2026 end, roughly $600 million remained under the prior authorization expiring December 31, 2026. The new total equals about 26% of market capitalization at current prices. Non-Executive Chairman Gregory C. Smith cited board confidence in free cash flow. Since 2011, Lear repurchased 63.6 million shares for $6.1 billion, a roughly 60% share-count reduction. Watch buyback pace, cash deployment versus M&A, and any leverage or margin pressure.
